name: revenuedot
description: Manage your mobile app's subscriptions and in-app purchases from chat: check MRR, look up customers, grant or extend access, set up plans and paywall offerings, and fix App Store and Google Play issues.

interface.longDescription: Manage your iOS and Android app's subscriptions and in-app purchases from chat. Connect your RevenueDot project to check MRR and revenue, find a customer by email or app user id and see why they lost access, grant or extend access, cancel with your confirmation, set up plans and paywall offerings, and fix App Store, Google Play and webhook problems. RevenueDot is an open-source subscription backend for mobile apps. It never asks for store keys or passwords.
defaultPrompt: How is revenue this month, and did any webhook fail?
Find the customer with email jane@example.com and tell me why they lost access.
Set up monthly and annual Pro plans behind a pro entitlement.
